gloss: either is fine; whichever; I don't mind either way

definitions.gloss: either is fine; whichever; I don't care which
definitions.explanation: Casual version of どちらでもいい. The speaker has no preference between two options. Tone ranges from genuinely easy-going to annoyed (couldn't care less), depending on delivery.

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{紅茶|こうちゃ}→紅茶：02878_koucha⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、どっちでもいい⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{決|き}めて→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: Coffee or tea, either one — just decide quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧どっちでもいい⟦{気分|きぶん}→気分：01306_kibun⟧だ。
examples.english: Honestly, right now I don't really care either way how it turns out.

notes:
Casual contraction of ⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧. The ⟦どっち→どっち：02922_docchi⟧ is informal; the ⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ frame is the standard 'X is fine' permission/indifference structure.

REGISTER:
- Casual; in polite speech use ⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧です or ⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧です
- Tone matters: said warmly, it's accommodating; said curtly, it sounds dismissive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: standard, polite-neutral form
- ⟦どっち→どっち：02922_docchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{構|かま}わない: 'either is fine' — slightly more emphatic, often masculine
- ⟦なんでもいい→なんでもいい：10761_nandemoii⟧: anything is fine — when the choice space is open (not just two)
- お{任|まか}せ⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧: 'I leave it to you' — defers to the other person rather than expressing indifference
